name: hello-webapp

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Signs the user in through the platform's SSO (OAuth PKCE) before the greeting is shown.

description: The single-page React app, the only user-facing surface: it redirects unauthenticated visitors to SSO sign-in, then shows the plain 'Hello, World!' greeting with a sign-out control. It has no backend, stores no data and has no navigation, because the requirements ask for a single page.
